sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- Civil Judge (Senior Division) Balrampur And 5 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Prashant Tiwari,Hariom Divedi,Manoj Kumar Singh Hon'ble Alok Mathur,J. 
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. on behalf of the State.

2. Present petition under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed to expedite the proceedings of complaint case No.2318 of 2023 (Smt. Soni VS. Shivakant @ Atul and others) pending since 17.7.2023 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act pending before Civil Judge (Senior Division), Balrampur.

entities.text: Soni VS. Shivakant @ Atul and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. It has been submitted that the petitioner has instituted the said proceedings against her husband and her in-laws and has prayed for their summoning.

It has been stated that the matter is urgent and a perusal of the order sheet clearly indicates that though the case is regularly listed but it is routinely adjourned on one pretext or the other.
Soni

vs Civil Judge (Senior Division) ... on 29 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147516624/
1
4. It is noticed that the instant matter relates to 2023 and the trial courts are heavily burdened with the dockets due to which large number of cases are pending before them.
In the present case, no extraordinary circumstance has been indicated by the petitioner so as to interfere and pass orders for expeditious disposal of the suit which has been filed only in 2023.

Accordingly, no case for interference is made out at this stage.
5.
However, looking to the aforesaid circumstances, liberty is granted to the petitioner to move appropriate application before the trial court within next two weeks for expediting the proceedings.
In case, such an application is made, the trail court shall consider and decide the same within two weeks thereafter by a reasoned and speaking order.

In case, the trial court finds that a case for urgency has been made out, it shall proceed to consider and decide the case of the petitioner expeditiously.
6.
With aforesaid direction the petition stands disposed of.

(Alok Mathur, J.) Order Date :- 29.5.2025 RKM.
